title: Great Stuff
body:
This is day three. I subscribed so I could get right into it.  

Love the interface and the approach. For example, dividing the day’s targets into groups of morning, afternoon and evening keeps the list small and enhances focus.  Very important for habit forming.  You still get configurable reminders so great idea. 

I had to spend a good 10 minutes setting things up and learning how it worked so that I was confident I was using it to its best.  I’d suggest this is important if tracking multiple things from the start is important to you as there appears no way to retrospectively create entries earlier than the create date. That’s one feature I’d like to see in a future release. 

I also wish it could also track the count of things within a task, like pushups for example.  

One thing it has that other products I looked at was an elegant way of tracking things that you want to happen in periods other than daily, and it not feel like you miss days. For example, a goal of swimming 3 times a week can be tracked and hitting it is great because you don’t have to “miss” the days in between.  

It’s easy to use, looks good, is well designed and after three days, I’m 100% on everything.  Wonder how long I can keep that up :)
